method: Four fresh Electron development profiles using rebuilt production renderers and real preload/SQLite/PCM, sequential ABBA. Each fixture has a first invocation after normal default Speed prewarm and two repeats per profile. Related preceding fixtures can warm the same engine. Click timers require a new audio identity, completed success/no pending/error and the same painted waveform at two animation-frame boundaries. All observations remain included. No statistical confidence or universal per-entry speedup is inferred.
limits: Two fresh profiles per variant; shared WSL host, JIT, GC and other workloads are uncontrolled.
Canvas software rendered under Xvfb. Frame values summarize each observed probe and cannot establish GPU presentation FPS.
Fixture admission, menu preparation, editor loading and normal Speed prewarm are outside click timers.
Per-profile frame summaries are aggregated as observations, rather than reconstructing or pooling individual frame intervals.
